name: phion
description: Intent-first discovery, preflight and verified routing for autonomous agents through PHION's remote MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connects agents to PHION's decision MCP surface for capability discovery, request preflight, route comparison and verification. Start with the free phion_resolve tool; paid execution always requires separate authorization.
defaultPrompt: Use phion_resolve to find the lowest-residual-work route for this task without authorizing payment.
Preflight this task with PHION and explain any required inputs before execution.
Show the PHION route, estimated cost and verification evidence before any paid action.
